spec.description: Creates specification by asking clarifying questions
spec.template:
Load and follow the skill spec in .opencode/skills/spec/SKILL.md.

Feature: $ARGUMENTS

spec-impl.template:
Load and follow the skill spec in .opencode/skills/spec-impl/SKILL.md.

Feature: $ARGUMENTS

verify-spec.description: Verifies the acceptance criteria of a spec, fixes code issues and reports results
verify-spec.template:
Verify the acceptance criteria of the spec $ARGUMENTS.

Find the spec file in `specs/` (the user may have written the number like `01`, the slug like `home-feed`, or the full name `01-home-feed`). Read it, locate the acceptance criteria section, verify each criterion, fix any code issues you find, mark the checkboxes in the spec file, and report a summary at the end.

commit-msg.description: Generate a commit message from current changes (does NOT commit)
commit-msg.template:
Write a git commit message for the current changes.

Git status:
!`git status --short`

Staged changes:
!`git diff --staged`

Unstaged changes:
!`git diff`

If there are staged changes, base the message on those; otherwise use all changes. Follow the repo's existing commit style and use Conventional Commits prefixes (e.g. feat:, fix:, docs:, refactor:, chore:) where relevant, since the project uses release-please.
